title: Print Glossary Mechanism
description: Add glossary mechanism to print LaTeX stack: GlossaryDefine/Gls usage tracking, Term/Definition/Pages table at end via listofglossaries, replacing unused semioglossary register stub.
summary: Fixed muted chip canvas fill overshooting border on right/bottom. Root cause: \semio@heading@cap@muted@core used \colorbox without \fboxsep=0pt (default 3pt padding caused 6pt width / 3pt height overflow past hairline strokes). Added \begingroup\setlength{\fboxsep}{0pt} guard matching colored \semio@window@cap. Verified: verify-paragraph.log has no 6pt overfull warnings; full zwischenbericht rebuild clean; high-zoom PNGs in ticket folder.
